reviews.text:
This is a quiet and calm restaurant.  It's a structure that you can easily see in Japan, with a central kitchen and tables around the kitchen, which is fun and nice.

For food, you buy a ticket directly at the entrance and show the ticket to the staff at the entrance. When you enter the restaurant, you will see a message asking you not to make loud noises and if you need water, side dishes, etc., to place them in front of the table.

Food is prepared in a very neat and systematic way, and this process is done in front of you, so you can trust the cleanliness.

While the food served at many franchise Vietnamese pho restaurants in Korea recently has a standardized taste that has been changed to suit domestic tastes, the pho here has a very rich taste that is quite similar to the pho served in Vietnam.  I personally liked it very much and it was delicious.  Also, the quality of the meat used in the noodles was quite good, and the tendon in particular was delicious to a level that is difficult to find in any pho restaurant.

For reference, there are three sauces provided as standard, and both of the red sauces are quite spicy.  Don't add too much to the soup at first. ^^

Highly recommended.

If you are looking for a restaurant full of Christmas atmosphere, I highly recommend this place!
It's conveniently located between Gangnam Station and Yeoksam Station, and the store is spacious, so it's perfect for everything from dates to year-end gatherings.

From the entrance, the tree and decorations created a perfect holiday atmosphere, and the staff were so friendly from the moment of reservation that I felt good even before visiting. There is also a group room inside, making it a great place for family gatherings or company dinners.

We ordered a steak pizza and a red shrimp aglio olio pasta, both of which were excellent.
The steak was thick, the ink dough was crispy, and the combination of sweet onions and ample cheese was perfect, making it the most delicious pizza I've ever had.
The red shrimp aglio olio pasta had a subtle ink aroma and excellent umami flavor, and the shrimp were really plump and had the best texture.

There are a variety of set menus to set the mood for the end of the year, and there is also a free pizza event for birthdays, making it a perfect place for an anniversary meal.

I am satisfied with the food, service, and atmosphere, so I would like to visit again. I really recommend it to anyone looking for atmospheric western food in Gangnam!

I went to August Hill Gangnam branch, which is selling a year-end limited set. I wanted to have a special meal at the end of the year due to my birthday, so I made a reservation on Naver in advance and visited. It is a large restaurant with good accessibility on foot from Shinnonhyeon Station and occupies the basement to the second floor. The atmosphere was unique from the outside, and the interior had a wood-toned interior and soft lighting that went well with the year-end atmosphere. In particular, the basement space had a high ceiling and grandeur, so it almost didn't feel like it was underground.

The year-end limited set consists of 300g striploin steak, half lobster & shrimp plate, pasta, pumpkin soup, and 2 glasses of wine. The amount and composition were really generous. I ordered the steak medium rare, and it was grilled perfectly on the outside and inside, and it maintained its flavor even when it cooled, so I was satisfied. The seafood was plump and chewy, exceeding expectations. Overall, I am satisfied with both the atmosphere and the taste, so I would recommend it for year-end gatherings or anniversaries.

reviews.author: PBHQ
reviews.text: Cry Cheese Burger is said to be a new brand created after 10 years of thought, and the brand slogan is simple, fresh, and friendly. As per the slogan, the focus is on cost-effectiveness. Visually, the hamburger character was placed on the front, and the mint green and yellow Pantone marigold colors were placed, and it seems that the branding target was aimed at people in their 20s and 30s. You can order hamburgers through a kiosk, and when you first click, a set of 6 hamburgers is recommended, but in reality, it is an arranged version of a single menu, and if you add cheese, it becomes a cheeseburger. It's really simple. The bread used was a brioche bun, and the patty was rather voluminous for the price. Since I've always had doubles since the Cry Cheese Burger, I ordered a double. And you can choose between red onions and grilled onions (just like with the Cry Cheese Burger). I think it was intentional, but since the meat is on the bottom and the vegetables are on top, you can enjoy the sweetness of the vegetables first when you eat it from the top. It's a classic design that starts with a soft and fluffy brioche bun, starts with tomato slices and ketchup, and finishes with pickles to give the weight of the cheese and patty. In terms of design, it resembles a Big Mac, but it feels a bit more luxurious. However, I think they tried to reduce the greasiness and emphasize the texture by sprinkling salt on the outside, so the first taste was a bit salty. Personally, the recommended combination is cheese + double, add grilled onions, and sprinkle a lot of pepper. Pepper must be sprinkled on a separate self-serve basis. Of course, if you like something light, you can omit it according to your taste.

reviews.author: David Weller K.
reviews.text:
🍔 Tuesday Burger & Wings — A small shop that boasts deep and honest taste

There is a small burger shop hidden in a quiet alley in Yeoksam-dong.
The orange sign catches the eye.
Tuesday Burgers & Wings.
Even from the name of the store, it already gives off a comfortable and cozy feeling. Like a lazy afternoon with no need to rush.

The store is small.
There are only a few tables, so you can feel the warmth of chatting with others nearby.

Next time, I think it would be better to order takeout or delivery.
Still, that small space has a special charm.
A quiet hum, the smell of slightly sizzling oil, and the soft glow of kitchen lighting.

Today's order was simple.
👉 "Tuesday Burger (Double Patty)"
👉 "Nashville Hot Chicken (Two Pieces)"
👉 And a can of Dr. Pepper Zero.

Let's start with chicken.
Pickles came with it, and they were crunchy and refreshing.
The chicken itself was surprisingly good.
The balance of seasoning was perfect,
The seasoning seeped deep into the meat, as if sunlight was seeping through cracks in old stones.
Every bite was rich, flavorful and honest.
The owner doesn't miss even the smallest detail.
It seemed like they put the same amount of care into making a piece of chicken as they would a piece of burger.

The owner welcomed everyone with a quiet smile.
It was the kind of smile that made you feel welcome without the need to express it in words.
It's hard to fake that kind of warmth.
And maybe that's why this place feels so special.
Because someone genuinely enjoys being here and doing what they love.

The burger was not juicy, but
It was full of depth and balance.
It was nutty, flavorful and simple, but far from ordinary.
The patty in particular had an impressive texture,
It was dense and full of flavor, like the low hum of a double bass line in a jazz album.
It was a subtle but unforgettable taste.

After eating, I entered a narrow alley.
I thought to myself, “If I lived nearby, I would come often.”
Next time I might come for takeout, delivery, or just a beer with a platter.
This is exactly that kind of place.
It's a small, honest, and quietly confident place.

Tuesday Burger & Wing is more than just a burger restaurant.
It reminds us that delicious food doesn't have to be fancy.
You just have to put your heart into it and make it.

reviews.text: The burger patty was delicious and full of meat. I had the avocado burger and I think all the ingredients went well together. There are many types of fries, so we recommend trying them together! Drinks are refillable.

reviews.author: JIMIN CHOI
reviews.text:
Today, I went to Downtowner Gangnam, a famous hamburger restaurant near Gangnam Station.
These days, I keep thinking about burgers, so I visited the Downtowner Gangnam branch, which I had visited before and enjoyed.
There are so many good restaurants in Gangnam Station that it's not easy to choose, but since I really wanted a spicy, yet not greasy burger on this day, Downtowner was the perfect choice. This place is already famous on social media as “the ultimate handmade burger” and “a refreshing restaurant in the burger world.” The store has a clean and stylish interior, making it great not only for eating but also for taking pictures.

reviews.author: kwanghee1
reviews.text: The atmosphere and taste were all good.

reviews.author: Changmo
reviews.text: It was so delicious. There are a lot of orders for delivery, so you may have to wait a bit, but I'm really satisfied!

address: 1st floor, 28 Gangnam-daero 98-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Noh Hye-jeong
reviews.text:
If you want to taste real, authentic American food, be sure to go here!!
Lively, unique and hip atmosphere and friendly staff❤️
Plus, it has a really deep and rich American taste!! Impressed👍
The lasagna was delicious, but I personally really enjoyed the mac and cheese and paneer cream pasta😋
There may already be a wait for hot flow, so we recommend making a reservation in advance or going for an open run~~~

reviews.author: pastel
reviews.text:
I went to 82 Orleans for my birthday.
There were so many delicious-looking menu items that it was difficult to choose. I ate lasagna and the new menu item, Pane Cream Pasta and Orleans Steak. Overall, the food plating was pretty. The steak was medium well done and soft, and the pane cream pasta was also very soft and delicious. It was the best to eat bread filled with cream at the end. The lasagna was delicious because it had a sour tomato sauce, and it was full of layers of meat and vegetables, so I was satisfied because I felt like I was eating a classic lasagna. I'm so glad I had such a happy and successful anniversary meal😊

reviews.author: Jeong Ga-hye
reviews.text: The atmosphere of the store was so pretty and everything I ordered was delicious!! Every time I come to Gangnam, I worry about what to eat, but 82 Orleans is a Gangnam restaurant that you won't miss!! I plan to visit again because I'm curious about other menus ❤️❤️ The store is spacious and has a nice atmosphere, so it's recommended as a meeting place at Gangnam Station >.

reviews.author: Park So-hyun
reviews.text: 82 Orleans, a Western restaurant with American sensibility! Is there a need to go that far? The atmosphere and foreign sensibility are perfect. I can feel that they put a lot of thought into every single item. Not everyone goes there just because the atmosphere is good, but the most important thing is that the taste is really good! This place is a success no matter what menu you order. Next time I visit, I will definitely try the milkshake. 82 Orleans' lasagna, pasta, and gnocchi were all delicious! I highly recommend Gangnam Station as a date and meeting place~👏

reviews.author: senie
reviews.text:
# Menu: Montecristo 15.0, Orleans Pilaf 19.0, Lasagna 18.0, Double Potato Gnocchi 9.0, Coleslaw 3.0
The menu prices were a bit expensive, but it was delicious. It has a new American home-style feel, and the interior of the store is decorated in an American style. When the weather is nice like these days, the windows are wide open, so the breeze is cool and nice. It's a restaurant worth stopping by at least once in Gangnam Station, and I especially liked the Montecristo because it's a dish that's hard to taste anywhere else!

reviews.author: Holyoli
reviews.text: Tiger shrimp butter mole is the best! The plump shrimp and well-cooked potatoes were delicious, and most of all, the mole was perfect for my taste, so I kept dipping it in the roti👍 The snacks were delicious, so I went for tequila shots all the time😆 I had a great time eating exotic food in a dimly lit space :)

reviews.author: z_zino
reviews.text: I think it would be good to go on a date at least once. The food was as good as expected and I didn't have to wait to eat it. The staff were really friendly and the atmosphere was nice~~!

reviews.author: Kim Young-gil
reviews.text:
I went there with high expectations since it was broadcast, but it wasn't as delicious as I expected, the food came out a little cold, and it didn't taste as good as I expected from the broadcast, so I was disappointed.

And although it opens at 5 o'clock, I was surprised that there was a line from the moment it opened. I came here with my family to try it out, but the food didn't taste as good as I expected, so I don't think I'll come back again, but if you're curious, give it a try.

But the fish taco was really delicious. But the atmosphere was nice, so it seemed like a good place to go on a date or chat with friends. And when I saw it on my way home and saw that there was a line up until 9pm, I thought it was a really great store.

reviews.author: Seonah Kim (tuddk112)
reviews.text:
The atmosphere is so good
I had a great time at a unique place with my friends for the first time in a while. Biriyam ramen had a spicy kick at the end and was so delicious.

reviews.author: Cuppa
reviews.text:
If it's trendy, you have to go there... I went there because I'm crazy about trends... I think it's good for dates or flirting.

The atmosphere is so noisy and dark that you can't concentrate just to go there for a meal.

The food was delicious. The seasoning was a bit strong, but it was very good.

editorial_summary: It is a trendy counter-order chain that sells upscale versions of classic fast food such as burgers and custard ice cream.

reviews.author: Young Suh
reviews.text:
Although it is a bit pricey, I am always satisfied with the Shake Shack burger.
It's especially good combined with a milkshake.

reviews.author: Jin Minwoo
reviews.text: Of course, Shake Shack has shakes + fries! Of course, the burgers are also very delicious.

reviews.author: Cuppa
reviews.text: It's been a long time since I came here, but I finally ate it, and it was delicious, but it didn't feel incredibly delicious...

reviews.author: Sunmi Kim
reviews.text: A burger with soft buns and juicy patties. I recommend it when you want to eat deliciously without counting calories just once. (Disappointing: No option to remove ice from drinks)

reviews.author: winter lion
reviews.text: It was nice to have valet parking (3,000 won, 2 hours). The French fries were delicious and the hamburger bun and patty were all satisfactory. There doesn't seem to be a set menu and it seems a bit salty for foreigners' tastes.

editorial_summary: This fast food chain serves made-to-order burgers, fries, and hot dogs and offers free peanuts while you wait.

reviews.author: EDDY KIM
reviews.text: This is the Korean branch of the American hamburger franchise Five Guys. The menu I ordered was the standard size Bacon Cheeseburger All The Way. Compared to existing small hamburger franchises in Korea, it seems to be about twice the size. Toppings are also plentiful. It's a bit big for an adult man to eat alone. There are plenty of French fries even if you order small ones. The burgers are big and really tasty, but I wonder if the prices are reasonable. The store is clean and offers free peanuts and unlimited drink refills.

reviews.author: Kelly101
reviews.text: As expected, it is a proven taste. It's so delicious. The meat is juicy and delicious with the cheese and pickles. Even if there are a lot of people, the food comes out very quickly. I come here when I want to eat a really heavy American hamburger style.

reviews.author: Aenon K
reviews.text: Hamburgers are famous for being very delicious, but the fries are a real treat. It's plentiful and delicious ♡ If you like spicy food, I highly recommend the fries with seasoning. The milkshake is also creamy and delicious. Delivery is also available, but they do not deliver during busy times. I highly recommend visiting and eating there. The store is also very friendly~

reviews.author: Woohyuk Jeon
reviews.text:
Have you ever stood in line for a burger because there was no room?

I'm crazy about french fries. If you want to eat 10,000 won worth of french fries, go for it.

If you want to eat a delicious hamburger, go to a handmade burger restaurant near your neighborhood.

If you want a milkshake, get a McDonald's McFlurry.

If you want to eat expensive food, spend that money and go to a western restaurant.

If it happens in my neighborhood, I won't go.

reviews.author: SailorJun
reviews.text: I ordered large french fries, but there were too many, so I had some left over. Even if you want to eat a lot, order medium. I am concerned about the unique bitter taste of peanut oil. The burger tastes good and greasy, but the price... I'm not sure. There are many burger places that are cheaper and taste better. I experienced it once, so it's okay.. I think I'll go to Downtowner or Bath Burger.

address: 1st floor, 75 Gangnam-daero 94-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Hime Park
reviews.text:
Salmon Poke + Tofu Croutons and Sweet Box Pro a perfect meal! 💚

These days, it's best to eat a light and healthy lunch.
So the place I went to was Balance Poke Yeoksam Branch!
As the name suggests, this is a place where you can enjoy a truly ‘balanced’ meal.
Super satisfied!!!

reviews.author: Sol Kim
reviews.text: This is a salad and poke restaurant open 24 hours a day near Yeoksam Station. I had the brisket poke and it was filling because the meat was plentiful and went well with the fresh vegetables. The grapefruit ade was refreshing and good to eat with it, and the store was clean, so it's recommended for office workers' lunch or eating alone.

reviews.author: leeyu
reviews.text: Very delicious Dtoganjip Poke Balance Poke As a resident of Yeoksam, this is the most delicious poke place around here. The portions are generous, the taste is good, the ingredients are fresh, and it's the best haha.

reviews.author: Fig
reviews.text: The composition is solid and delicious. If you are looking for a healthy lunch menu near Yeoksam Station or if you are looking for a salad in Yeoksam-dong, I highly recommend Balance Poke Yeoksam branch!

reviews.author: Eunjoo Kwon
reviews.text:
I happened to stop by Balance Poke while visiting Yeoksam 😇
Because it was cold, I ordered sweet box franc and salmon buckwheat noodles.
It's really ㅠㅠ It's a really delicious combination! The sweet potato soup is deep and rich, and the salmon buckwheat noodles are sour.
The flying fish roe bursts brightly and goes really well with hijiki, salmon, and buckwheat noodles. It's a shame that the amount decreases as you eat it.
I also added avocado and mixed grain rice, and it was a filling meal❤️ The staff is also friendly, so I'll visit again next time 💨

reviews.author: Loha Yun
reviews.text: This is a great handmade burger restaurant!! The bread is made in-house, so it's very soft. I heard that the shrimp burgers here are delicious, so I had the shrimp burger and chicken tenders, and they were amazing. I recommend them. +_+

reviews.author: food_dairy bang
reviews.text: This is a handmade burger restaurant with the charm of buns and lettuce. They make chicken burgers better than regular patty burgers, and they have the charm of crispiness and crunchiness. This is a handmade burger restaurant in Yeoksam that sells out quickly if you go late in the evening.

reviews.author: Mark Wongyeom choi
reviews.text: Mushroom Burger (Shroom Burger) has a very strong mushroom flavor! Recommended for those who like mushrooms!

reviews.author: Choon Lee
reviews.text: I heard that there is a handmade burger restaurant in Yeoksam-dong, so I stopped by. The store has an ambiguous structure, so it was difficult to find the entrance. I ate the cheeseburger set with onion rings. The bun is a bit unusual. It's not a regular bread, but feels like an English muffin, so it's soft. Onion rings are delicious on the outside and inside. The price isn't bad either.

reviews.author: JS JUNG
reviews.text:
It was my first time stopping by Smash Cheeseburger.
The flavor and taste of the handmade burger was good.
It was better than the Shake Shack burger, but the portion size seemed a bit small.
I also recommend the side menu, onion rings.👍

reviews.author: slosaeng
reviews.text: Maybe it's because it's been a while since I had a Bath Burger, but it was really delicious..🤍 It's unlimited refills of James Gam's potato chips, and I wonder if the quality can be this good! The Mushroom Burger had as many as two whole fried shiitake mushrooms, and it also had a patty, so the flavor was amazing 💕 It's a unique burger that you can only get at Bath Burger, so I highly recommend it 👍👍👍 The atmosphere is very nice, like a craft beer house.

reviews.author: Pipipi
reviews.text:
I visited with a child and an adult, and it was much more comfortable and satisfying than I expected.
I went for lunch on a Sunday, and there weren't many people, so I was able to eat leisurely, and I saw a lot of people eating alone.

You order and pick up at your seat, and if you eat at the store, you get unlimited refills of French fries, so it's perfect to order as a combo.
The Bath Burger's patty was moist and juicy, so it was good to share with children, and the Mushroom Burger was really delicious because the fried shiitake mushrooms were crispy.
The Wasabi Mayo Shrimp Burger has a great wasabi flavor, so I recommend it to those who like unique menu items.

The mozza cheese bar is made with real mozzarella, so if you like cheese, be sure to add it.
I heard that they have a variety of beers and free tastings, so I want to try it with beer next time.

reviews.author: Shubung
reviews.text:
It’s a handmade burger restaurant right near Exit 3 of Yeoksam Station. The patty was still juicy, so the burger taste was authentic, and the Hawaiian burger wasn't too greasy thanks to the pineapple, so I enjoyed it until the end. The Bath Burger has a classic taste, so it's delicious and doesn't go out of style.

I was satisfied with the French fries and sweet potato fries, and there was a potato chip self-serve bar so I kept eating them. The restrooms inside the store were also clean, so it was great to eat comfortably!

reviews.author: Chaerin
reviews.text:
A handmade burger restaurant that is already popular among office workers at Yeoksam Station.
When I went there in person, I immediately understood why it was so popular👍🏻

The patty is moist and the menu can be customized.
You can enjoy it however you like, and unlimited potato chip refills are a huge plus!🤭🩷

Overall, I was satisfied with the taste, atmosphere, and convenience.
I 100% intend to visit again next time🩷🩷🩷

reviews.author: Linen Kitchen
reviews.text: It’s been a while since I went to Bath Burger Yeoksam!! I was curious about the new menu, so I enjoyed the burger and craft beer. I think I'll come back more often because they always serve me so kindly no matter when I visit!! The broccoli and bacon are grilled so well over the fire that there is no need to mention the burger as a drink menu. Since it is Yeoksam Station, I recommend the Geuncho handmade burger restaurant at Gangnam Station.

reviews.author: LaPiel
reviews.text:
Name changed recently. “Feel and Feel”
The interior is the same.

With fewer employees, it becomes more difficult to eat during lunch hours on weekdays.
In fact, I ordered around 12 o'clock, but the burger was not ready until 30 minutes later.
I definitely came to eat fast food, but it seemed slower than pizza.

There is a Bath Burger nearby, so I recommend going there even if you have to wait. Is it worth waiting 30 minutes to eat?

reviews.author: C H

reviews.author: Garcia Kim
reviews.text:
I am a person who travels around Gangnam and eats homemade burgers.
It's delicious, cost-effective, and the best.
The high-quality bun is grilled with butter, and the patty is a delicious meat patty that is slightly Koreanized. It's especially nice that drinks are refilled when ordering a set.
What's disappointing is that the French fries are thin, so it's a bit disappointing that they give you pre-fried snacks because they're like a crispy snack.
It was so delicious I forgot to take a picture.
I'll go again next time and update.

reviews.author: Joo Hyeong Kim
reviews.text: I watched it on YouTube and it was delicious. It was dinner time, so I waited for about 10 minutes. The price is also affordable in Yeoksam and Seolleung.

reviews.author: Taeksu Kim
reviews.text: It's been a while since I tasted something close to an American burger (double cheese, BBLT). They make it right after you order, but it comes out quickly and the turnover is fast, so you don't have to wait long. The owner is also friendly and I plan to go again.

reviews.author: Gwang
reviews.text: I haven't tried many tacos, but they suited my taste well. There wasn't a strong scent of spice at all. When you order tacos, you get 3 pieces, which may seem like a small amount, but my stomach is still quite full. There are no hard taco shells, only soft ones. They say they make the shell themselves.

reviews.author: gawon hwang
reviews.text:
A local Mexican restaurant with a taste that is different from other restaurants.
Perhaps because they make the tortillas themselves, they are chewy and delicious.
The portion was generous and the taste was clean.
I especially recommend the carnitas tacos.

reviews.author: C JJ
reviews.text:
It's just a casual restaurant. The owner doesn't want to do business, but he forces himself to do it.
Basically, the food itself is tasteless.
The tortilla was undercooked, the meat tasted like paper, and the sauce was bland.

reviews.author: Coco Choi
reviews.text: Actually, there is nothing special about the burgers, but this restaurant wins in terms of juiciness. There are a lot of bun patty buns these days, and I think they are lighter and more delicious than Shake Shack 🍔

reviews.author: cray
reviews.text: The burger is absolutely delicious. Cheese fries are a bit salty. If you eat it while it's warm, you won't know it's salty, but if you eat it when it's cold, it's very salty. But the burger is the best.

reviews.author: Allegro Vivace Kerry ZZ Zin
reviews.text:
Kindness ★★★★☆
Cleanliness ★★★★☆
Taste ★★★★★
Revisit ★★★★★

The bun patty bun that I thought was only available in Seocho and The Hyundai was found in Gangnam, so I went looking for it.
As expected, the patty buns are so delicious.
The taste of light and salt for me who used to only eat Shake Shack.
The rich and salty taste of Shake Shack is stronger, but
The bun patty bun has a fantastic taste of bread that touches your tongue as soon as you bite into it and the taste of the patty you feel when you take a bite.
The most delicious handmade burger I've ever had, a patty bun, has opened in Gangnam, bringing tears to my eyes.

Everyone, please eat three times.

reviews.author: Woo Il-sang (iswoob)
reviews.text:
Bun is really special,
The patty tastes good,
There is always no mess,
I use Heinz Tomato Ketchup (I can't really tell the difference).
There are plenty of seats,

reviews.author: Kim Wontae (gaolisk)
reviews.text: I was sad that the bun patty bun in Garosu-gil was gone, but it opened in Gangnam Station, so I ate it for the first time in a long time. I was relieved that the taste was still the same.

reviews.author: 27 GB
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed it!!!
It's a franchise I found out about at Lil's, and I really liked it because it tasted better than I expected :DDDD

I tried three types of chicken and Cajun corn: Louisiana Rub, Original Buffalo, and Hickory Smokey BBQ.

Chicken in general has a very strong flavor, so there are likely to be likes and dislikes, but Louisiana Rub has a taste that anyone can enjoy. The chicken is really crispy and melts in your mouth!

The corn is really delicious, but I think it's a bit lacking compared to the chicken. For the sauce, I had ranch sauce, which also had a sour taste, so it was a menu item that may vary from person to person.

reviews.author: My own reasons
reviews.text: The biggest appeal of Wing Stop's wings is that you can choose the flavor according to your taste. Personally, I thought the garlic parmesan and lemon pepper went so well with wings that I even dipped the fries in the sauce. If you only look at the first floor, you might think the store is small, but if you go up to the second floor, there is a zone where you can look down on the streets of Gangnam Station through a wide glass window and a rooftop, so on a nice day, it would be nice to eat chicken with beer at night. Be sure to try the Cajun Fried Corn, Wing Stop's favorite menu item, which was highly praised by an American friend. It's a taste that I really want to eat again. It's nice to be able to eat Wing Stop in Gangnam, which I used to eat in the US. While at Wingstop, foreign customers are constantly coming in, but the global brands are different. Eat well :)

reviews.author: Vismood Velvet (Visbimmer0120)
reviews.text:
October
I like lemon pepper and wrench. Hickory and original are both delicious. It's sweet when eaten with mango sauce.
As it is Korea, there is no Korean spicy sauce. Gochujang is a delicious and sweet sauce that recently became a hit in the United States. Another difference from American stores is that you cannot watch the cooking process through transparent glass. But here in Gangnam, there is a rooftop. I ate at the rooftop today and was able to feel the American vibe for the first time in a while. Because the view was ordinary, it could have felt like it was only a rooftop with a pattern, but I think the atmosphere of the rooftop itself is not bad. The overall store atmosphere seems to be good. On the other hand, the ranch sauce has a cheesy taste, similar to blue cheese sauce, but oh... I couldn't take another picture of the food because I was inhaling so much. After all, beer is chicken, and chicken is beer. Wings are wrench sauce!! Meanwhile, the French fries are a bit salty like the lemon pepper wings here, but when eaten with the ranch dipping sauce, mango dipping sauce, and ketchup, they give a harmonious taste. 100% intention to visit again!
--------------------
November
Wow, Colesler is delicious. It's thick and not mushy, which I like, so it has a good texture. I'm talking about the vegetables in the chicken wing burger, but I think they changed it a little bit. The draft beer is also quite delicious. Basically, it comes out cool and has a mild taste. I enjoyed it enough to eat it once or twice a week for a while in the US, and I hope it prospers in the future. There are a lot of people every time I go, and the wait was a bit long today. I fell in love with the taste of the Mango Habanero Chicken Wing Burger as if it was my first time trying it. I have a 100% feeling that I am a regular. Even as I write this, I want to eat more. Meanwhile, the atmosphere seems to be that of DJing on the rooftop.

reviews.author: Julia is traveling
reviews.text: Lots of different types of wings. The original buffalo tastes a little sour, so I recommend the lemon pepper. Spicy wings dipped in blue cheese are super delicious. If wings or French fries are greasy, it is recommended to eat them with celery as this reduces the greasiness.  The beer is also cold and delicious. The store is spacious, so it's good to have a beer with friends. It's nice because it's a vending machine ordering system, so you don't have to wait in line, just order and wait. Service is friendly.

reviews.author: Yeon Woo Kim
reviews.text:
As of August 2024, one of only two Wing Stop stores in the country. This is the 1st branch.
I thought it would be crowded, but there was no waiting line and it was quiet so I was able to have a pleasant meal.
The main wing menu consists of wings and rods, but they are very small.
It's no different from the wings sold anywhere else in Korea.
The other thing is the sauce on the outside, and it tastes nothing special other than the lemon pepper. Atomic sauce is also not very spicy for Koreans. Other buffalo wing restaurants in the U.S. have more types of sauces.
Unlimited refills on drinks.
There is a bathroom on the 2nd floor.
Currently, vegetable sticks are given as a review event.

reviews.author: Kyung Kim
reviews.text: I came late in the afternoon and it was nice and there were plenty of seats. I ordered beef tacos, but there is no cilantro in the basic taco. I think I need to add cilantro (500 won). I use soft shells, but taco shells are made with dough that contains more flour than corn, and the taste is just average. If you write a Naver review, they give you guacamole, and this is the real deal. It tastes good only after adding it to guacamole tacos. This seems to be a guacamole restaurant. I like tacos, so I've tried them a lot, but I don't think it's a very good restaurant, but it's nice that there's a taco restaurant nearby.

reviews.author: Son Eric
reviews.text:
I enjoyed the tacos
Chili Sausage Taco
Delicious~~

reviews.author: HT KIM
reviews.text:
Visited in April 2026.

I had a light beef burrito for dinner, and the combination of rice, vegetables, meat, and sauce was very good. Personally, I think it would have been better if there had been some coriander in it. Since there are so many likes and dislikes about cilantro, I think I made the easy choice to leave it out.

The store was neatly maintained. You can't see it in the picture, but there is a separate sink in front of the bathroom in the corner so you can wash your hands before and after eating.

I ordered through the kiosk, but it said on the order form that the order time was an hour later than it actually was. So, without realizing it, I thought that daylight saving time was applied in Korea as well.

Bear Starco is said to be California-style Mexican food. It seems they are serious about implementing the mainland American style, even applying daylight saving time, which is not commonly seen in Korea. If you want to taste authentic Mexican food with a real American taste, we recommend visiting Bear Starco Gangnam branch.

reviews.author: iu iu
reviews.text: I had the porterhouse because you recommended it... but the sirloin part was tougher than pork, so I left it behind. I think it would be better to just order the iron plate for one person.

reviews.author: Katelyn Lee
reviews.text:
I ordered and ate a teppan steak and a rare hamburger steak. The price was not expensive for the amount of steak and the meat was soft, but it had a bit of a smell. I had high expectations because I had enjoyed the rare hamburger steak at another store, but the name "rare" was meaningless, so it was overcooked and the hamburger steak just tasted like a beef patty. It wasn't very soft.
It was nice that you could bring your own unlimited rice and side dishes and get a 1,000 won discount if you didn't leave anything behind.

reviews.author: Luffy

Look at the gram and think about it. It may be difficult to eat because there are not many seats.

reviews.author: Youngmi Choi
reviews.text:
Gangnam Station Korean beef steak restaurant Bong Steak
A proper steak meal that was satisfying from the atmosphere to the taste.
If you are looking for a place near Gangnam Station that has a nice atmosphere but “definitely delicious meat,” Bong Steak, which I visited this time, is a place that I was really satisfied with. From the signboard, you can feel the simple sensibility, and from the moment you pass through the entrance and enter the store, you get the feeling that this is not just a restaurant, but a place where you can enjoy a meal.
The atmosphere of the store is, in a word,
It’s the perfect combination of warm wood tone + marble table + partition booth.
The wood-colored wall and vertical line lighting subtly blend together, making the entire space feel calm and luxurious. The lighting is not too bright, so it's easy on the eyes, and the atmosphere allows you to naturally focus on conversation and eating, making it a great place for dates, gatherings, and even family dinners.
The table has a marble pattern top, which is the real highlight.
When a steak plate is placed on a dark marble, the color of the meat comes out much more clearly, and when you take a picture, the luxurious feel is captured without any correction. There's a reason why everyone picks up their phones as soon as the food comes out.
The seating configuration is also very good.
There are many partitioned booth seats, so your line of sight is naturally separated from the table next to you, and even when the surrounding area is crowded, there is little disruption to conversation. On one side, tables for 2 to 4 people are neatly connected, and on the other side, there are spacious booth seats, so it looks like it's possible for a group visit. Even if you sit for a long time, you won't feel any burden, and the overall structure provides a good feeling of "comfort."
Ordering is done through tablets installed at each table, making it neat and convenient. The menu composition was easy to see at a glance, and I liked that I could place additional orders right away, so the flow of the meal wasn't interrupted.
The menu I ordered this time is
Korean beef steak tenderloin (120g), Korean beef steak strip tip (280g),
Also, there was Korean beef kimchi fried rice on a cheese plate and a mini salad bar.
First of all, the Korean beef tenderloin steak was truly tender. The texture naturally loosens from the moment the knife touches it, and when you put it in your mouth, it feels like it disappears moistly without any resistance. The unique savory aroma of dry aging remained subtle and not overpowering, so it was perfect to eat as my first steak.
Striploin steak definitely has a different presence.
The outside is well-grilled and has a savory flavor, and the more you chew, the more juicy and rich meat fills your mouth. Because the balance between fat and lean meat was good, I was able to enjoy it until the end without feeling greasy, and it was a menu that left me with the full satisfaction of “eating” the steak.
And an unexpected main dish, Korean beef kimchi fried rice on a cheese plate.
The kimchi fried rice is on top of the bubbling melted cheese, and the visual is already off-putting. It's a style that emphasizes the umami rather than the spiciness of kimchi, so it goes well after eating a steak, and it goes really well with leftover meat. I highly recommend it as a finishing menu.
Overall, the steak is
✔ Good atmosphere
✔ Photos come out well
✔ Authentic taste of meat
It was a place where all three elements were well-equipped.
It was a memorable place as a steak restaurant in Gangnam Station that you can visit not only on special days, but also on days when you want to eat a proper steak today.

If you are looking for quiet and comfortable accommodation in the heart of Gangnam, Seoul, Novotel Ambassador Seoul Gangnam is always a reliable choice. The room I stayed in this time was room 1617, located on the 16th floor. Although it is a hotel in the city center, the atmosphere was much more calm and orderly than I expected. As soon as I opened the door to the room, what I felt was a feeling of cleanliness and stability rather than splendor. The combination of wood-toned interior design and neutral colors gently embraces the entire space, and tension is naturally relieved from the moment you first enter.
There was a generously sized king bed in the center of the room, and the bedding was crisp yet cozy like a hotel. The mattress was firm without being too firm, making it good for a good night's sleep, and the soft lighting on the headboard made it easy on the eyes at night. There was a sofa space next to the bed, which was great for drinking coffee or taking a break, and I felt like the space was utilized efficiently.
Outside the window, you can see the cityscape of Gangnam at a glance. The view is a combination of high-rise buildings and low-rise residential areas. Although it is a busy city center, it feels rather calm when viewed from above. During the day, the sunlight comes in brightly, making the rooms bright, and in the evening, the city lights spread softly, creating a good atmosphere to end the day.
The desk and mirror space provided on one side of the room are very practical. It is large enough to work on a laptop, and there is no inconvenience in putting on makeup or putting away luggage. Welcome chocolate and bottled water were neatly prepared, so I felt a little consideration. The minibar area is neatly set up with a coffee machine, electric kettle, and mugs, making it a great place to spend some leisurely time in the room.
The bathroom was also bright and clean overall, and was equipped with a bidet, which was highly satisfactory. There were plenty of towels and amenities, and even a gown with the Novotel logo made it feel like staying at a hotel. Overall, Novotel Ambassador Seoul Gangnam #1617 is a quiet and stable room that makes you forget the location of Gangnam, and is a space that is well suited for business accommodation as well as those who want to relax in the city.

reviews.author: Seogun
reviews.text:
I visited the cafe because it was rumored to be a delicious brunch cafe, but I felt like I wasn't sure if it had the same quality as a good restaurant. The spacing between tables was narrow, so it was a bit uncomfortable, and the corner of the second floor where I was told my room was darker than I expected, so the lighting was bad for my eyesight.

I know there is a lot of waiting because it is a busy place for lunch and dinner, but it is not overcrowded and even if you tell your group that you will be arriving within 30 minutes, you just have to wait.

There were no seats available for waiting, so I sat in the corner for a while with the understanding of other guests on the first floor (it was not a shared seat that would disturb existing customers), but they said this was not a waiting seat.

They say that even if you order from the cafe menu, you will only be able to get directions to your seat if all of your party comes. Is there any service that is so unreasonable? That doesn't mean there's a lot of waiting behind me, but I feel a bit uncomfortable waiting.

Anyway, my group arrived and we were shown to our seats, but the room I mentioned earlier was too dark, so we changed seats, and while I was waiting, I felt the same, but they gave me a high price for a table.

By the way, the person wearing glasses who looks like the manager is a walk-in customer.
I wish I could learn Udri to quickly understand the status and table rotation and provide sensible guidance.

I write reviews to earn Google Guide points.

reviews.author: ethan ghymn
reviews.text:
As I was passing through the underground shopping mall of Gangnam Station on my way to a refreshing Daegu stew, I saw Brixand here, so I figured this was the store I had seen in Yerang's review before, and after enjoying a delicious meal of 50,000 Daegu, I stopped by on the way back.

When I saw it in the picture, the brick-shaped brick sand looked interesting and sized, but in reality, it was about the size of a typical financier, so I thought it was petite.

There was a customer in front of me waiting for my turn, and I was looking at the menu, and there was an advertisement on the wall that said, "Add 900 won to the drink price and get it with the basic brick." I was hesitant for a moment, but when I looked at the price of the drink, the Americano was 4,500 won. These days, there are a lot of stores that sell cheap, tasty and good-volume Americanos for around 2,000 won per cup of Americano. If you add 900 won to the 4,500 won, they end up paying full price. It felt like I was buying it, so it felt a bit like a gangster store.

I'll pass on the deal that isn't even a deal and ask for one basic financier brick and one basic sweet brick among the brick-shaped chocolate topped financiers. Would you please put them in the bag? When I asked and said it was okay, I took out one basic brick and one sweet brick that were individually packaged and refrigerated, so I accepted them and took them to my car and headed home.

When I got home and opened the package and tasted the basic financier, the basic brick, I noticed that the crust on the outside had a slightly chewy texture. box.

I thought that a good financier would have this kind of texture and taste, and the financier from Hbizite that I tried for the first time had a moderate crust on the outside and a soft, soft buttery scent and sweetness, which matched my expectations, but the basic financier brick here had a slightly chewy crust and was slightly moist rather than moist, so the feeling of butter coming out was a bit over-balanced, so I was a little confused.

The sweet brick, which is said to be topped with brick-shaped salted caramel-flavored Valrhona Dulce chocolate, actually looks like sushi with brick-shaped chocolate on top of a thin financier and neta on top of shari. You can coat the financier with chocolate, but this is a brick-shaped chunk of chocolate covered on a thin financier, so it's closer to the feeling of eating chocolate than the feeling of eating a financier. Why did they make this? As I like classic things, I don't necessarily feel like eating it again.

Of course, it's not that it doesn't taste good because it's sweet, but it's unbalanced, and especially the sweet brick feels like I'm not sure if I'm eating financier or chocolate, so if I want to eat chocolate with that feeling, I'd rather eat Japanese chiroru kinako mochi chocolate or matcha mochi chocolate.

I was curious because the brick-shaped visual overall looked interesting, but I happened to pass by and found Gagel, stopped by, bought it, and tried it. It didn't seem like they used poor materials or anything, but the perfection, quality, and balance were not good, so I didn't like it.
